summary: Restored Typesense and verified the Authentik-protected API Gateway catalog, runtime-assurance, and search flow on the declared production VMs.

verification.observed: Ansible completed with 414 OK, 149 changed, zero failures, and zero unreachable hosts.
Issuer discovery matched; client-credentials authentication succeeded without logging the token; anonymous access returned 401 and authenticated service/runtime-assurance routes returned 200.
Typesense health returned 200, the platform-services collection contained 78 documents, and authenticated structured search returned results from the Typesense backend.
The managed Restic hook protected all 5 governed sources with zero uncovered and zero inactive sources.

notes: The live apply was executed before the source changes were committed; this commit records the exact applied implementation and adds the header-normalization regression test.
The first apply attempt stopped before its catalog request because the local API-key file had a trailing newline. Consumer-side normalization was added and the governed apply then passed.
The temporary SSH tunnel was closed and its local listener removal verified. This receipt covers only Typesense and API Gateway, not completion of every Authentik consumer migration.
